note: Expectations of the SQL parts of the intent layer that Node cannot run without a database. Read from server/src/modules/intent/infrastructure/repository.ts and server/src/db/schema/reviews.ts (pr_intent) at d1c9093; the Postgres behaviours (numeric(12,6) rounding, NULL ordering) are stated from the PostgreSQL documentation, not generated. Consumer: the Go intent repository tests (S24, pgtest) and the S30 parity test.

get.name: row_with_null_derived_at
get.expect: no record: repository.get returns undefined when the row has no derived_at (repository.ts:21)

get.name: row_with_derived_at
get.expect: a record mapped by the intent mapper (goldens/intent.json mapper[])

upsert.updatedColumns: every column: intent, in_scope, out_of_scope, change_type, confidence, derived_from, sources, head_sha, input_hash, prompt_version, provider, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd, derived_at (repository.ts:44-49)
upsert.returning: the stored row, mapped (cost as stored)
upsert.nullables: change_type/confidence/derived_from default (null, null, 'inferred'); sources detail is stored as null when absent

commits.node: SELECT sha, message FROM pr_commits WHERE pr_id = $1 ORDER BY committed_at ASC (repository.ts:85)
commits.go: ORDER BY committed_at ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC (D5009: NULL last is Postgres' default for ASC; id breaks ties)

changedFiles: Node: SELECT path FROM pr_files WHERE pr_id = $1 with no ORDER BY (repository.ts:90), so the order is unspecified. It only matters for refresh: the first 100 paths become the 'Changed files:' lines of the inferred diff source (spec 7.4.3); the review path uses the parsed stored diff in diff order (spec 7.5).
